answer: With a Design mockup accepted by the project lead backed by a time-locked stake, the network asks for proof of craft before proof of personhood: the design mockup is reviewed line by line, the time-locked stake is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so fakes must pass the same review bar as honest contributors. The record keeps every cipher visible, so anyone can audit the work log. A nebula alone is noise; a willow of accepted work is a pattern the network can trust.
